none: PAS FindID 1016708: Roman coin: radiate of Gallienus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Silver-washed radiate of Gallienus, sole reign, (260-268), possibly Siscia mint. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: GALLIENVS AVG. Reverse description: Jove standing nude left, looking right with right arm raised holding thunderbolt, cloak floating behind to right; S in left field. Reverse inscription: IOVI [---T]ORI. Diameter: 21.4mm,…
